summary: Discusses where Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) is suitable for traffic engineering in IP networks. It covers deployment considerations in operational networks and points out the limits of the MPLS approach.

eli5.summary: Traffic engineering means steering cars so no road is jammed. This document says when using MPLS labels to steer internet traffic works well and when it does not.

questions: is mpls good for traffic engineering
what are the limits of mpls traffic engineering
